svg.title: TurboVLA inference pipeline on the NexArm
svg.desc: Camera views go through DINOv3 ViT-B/16 and a residual projection into 196 tokens of width 256 per view; the instruction goes through a frozen BERT and a linear layer; six interaction layers share one attention-logit matrix between image and text tokens and refine the text with a transformer layer; the joint state becomes two tokens; sixteen learned queries cross-attend to all of these in three pre-norm decoder layers; an MLP and tanh give a 16 by 6 chunk, of which the arm runs the first 8 before inferring again.
svg.text: TurboVLA reads the task, then plans 16 steps.

g.text: 224 × 224 RGB · ImageNet mean / std · V = 2 or 3
the dataset's task string; an empty
task falls back to a default prompt
each view separately · bf16 autocast · fine-tuned, lr 5e-5
+ view embedding efront​, ewrist​, etop​ → flatten
BiAttentionBlock with shared logits, then a text-only transformer layer
softmax over text · values Wvl​ l̄
softmax over image · values Wvv​ v̄
Add & LN → FFN 1024, ReLU → Add & LN
after the 8th action: new frames, next cycle
dropped, replaced by the next chunk
